The '''Boonta Cup''' was an award given to the winner of the annual [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]], during the years leading up to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].
